note: Shared header + sidebar chrome present on every authenticated screen (Mi Cuenta, Estado.aspx, Rastreo.aspx, PruebaExportacion.aspx, PreAlerta.aspx, PagoOnline.aspx). Documented once here; each screen's own component file lists only its screen-specific content and links back to this file rather than repeating these entries.

components.name: Sidebar collapse toggle (hamburger, class close-sidebar-btn)
components.action: Collapses/expands the left sidebar nav. No text label or aria-label captured — icon-only button, accessibility gap.

components.name: Mobile nav toggle (hamburger, class mobile-toggle-nav / mobile-toggle-header-nav)
components.action: Hidden at desktop viewport width; presumed to open the sidebar/header nav on mobile. Not tested at mobile viewport in this phase.

components.name: User menu trigger (<a class="p-0 btn">, no id, empty text)
components.action: Opens the top-right user dropdown menu. No accessible name (empty text, no aria-label) — icon/avatar-only trigger, accessibility gap.

components.name: Logged-in user display (name + email, inside the user dropdown)
components.action: Static text showing the account's full name and email (e.g. 'JOSE ALEXANDER CABREJA AYBAR' / 'jacabreja@hotmail.com'), visible once the dropdown is open. Not individually selectored (no distinct id/class captured), grouped with the dropdown here.

components.name: Salir (logout, inside user dropdown)
components.action: onclick="window.location.href='/Login.aspx'" — client-side redirect to Login.aspx, not a server logout call observed directly. Reversible via re-login; not treated as destructive. NOTE: see audit/notes/session-behavior.md — returning to Login.aspx after authenticating appears to invalidate the session even though the session cookie is unchanged, so this control's effect may be broader than a simple redirect.

components.name: Sidebar menu
components.action: Persistent left-nav list of links: 'Mi Cuenta' (href MiCuenta.aspx), 'Estados de Cuenta' (href Estado.aspx), 'Rastreo' (href Rastreo.aspx), 'Prueba de Exportacion' (href PruebaExportacion.aspx), 'PreAlerta' (href PreAlerta.aspx). The active item gets class 'mm-active'.

components.name: Pagos Online (sidebar link, hidden)
components.action: Real <a href="PagoOnline.aspx"> exists in the DOM on every authenticated screen but its parent <li> is display:none for this test account — not visible/clickable in the rendered UI. Confirmed hidden (not just styled) via computed-style + zero-size bounding rect check.

components.name: Footer text
components.action: Static, non-interactive: '2022 - DOMIPACK, TODOS LOS DERECHOS RESERVADOS.' plus three links — 'Términos y Condiciones de Uso', 'Políticas de Privacidad', 'Políticas de Entrega' — all with empty/missing href (href="" or none captured), i.e. dead links.
